module: "Bulk Rename" window (Assets menu) of the level editor: renames scene objects in bulk. You choose the field to rename (name or internalName), the set of objects (current selection, or objects whose name matches a pattern with * and ?), and a rename pattern where %n inserts a counter (%4n = 4 digits with zeros), and %o the old name. A preview table shows old name, new name, ID and collision ID; the rename goes through objectHistoryActions.changeObjectFieldMultipleValuesWithUndo (undoable).
notes: Name collisions are detected only for the name field (internalName may be duplicated); the RENAME button is not blocked in case of collision.
The search pattern is taken from the ImGui filter and passed to Sim.findObjectsByNameMask.

onEditorGui.desc: Called every editor frame: draws the Bulk Rename window (options, patterns, RENAME button, preview table).

onEditorInitialized.desc: Registers the "bulkRename" window (600x600) and the "Bulk Rename" menu entry (Assets group).

onEditorActivated.desc: Hook called when the editor is activated; empty function.

onEditorObjectSelectionChanged.desc: Hook called when the editor object selection changes; recomputes the name preview.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension is loaded; empty function.
